item.title: How to Top Up Your Transport Card
item.summary: A short guide explains three ways to put money on a city transport card and what to do if you lose it.
item.content_markdown:
With a transport card, you can travel on the metro, buses and city trains. When your card is empty, you need to top it up: this means you put more money on it. Here are three easy ways.

## At a machine

1. Find a ticket machine at any metro station.
2. Choose your language and touch "Top up card".
3. Put your card on the reader.
4. Choose how much money you want to add.
5. Pay by bank card or cash, and keep your card on the reader until you see "Done".

## In the app

Download the city transport app and add your card number. Then you can top up from your phone at any time, even at night. It is faster than the machine, but the money sometimes arrives after ten or fifteen minutes.

## At the ticket office

If you have a problem, go to the ticket office. The staff are usually very helpful.

**Lost your card?** Tell the ticket office or block it in the app. If your card is registered, you can get your money back on a new card.
